item.title: CVE-2024-5617 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 4.8
item.description:
Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 4.8 | The account lock feature fails to correctly enforce account lockouts on the primary user store when users with identical usernames exist in both primary and secondary user stores. This occurs because the lock condition is only applied to the secondary user store account in such scenarios, allowing continued authentication attempts against the primary user store account.
This functional flaw enables brute force attacks. By systematically attempting different passwords against the primary user store account, an attacker can potentially gain unauthorized access to sensitive information or accounts, as the intended account lockout mechanism does not prevent repeated login attempts.

item.title: CVE-2025-11969 - NVD - CVSS Score v3.1: 9.4
item.description:
Monday 2 November 2026 | NVD | CVSS Score v3.1: 9.4 | The System REST APIs do not correctly enforce access control mechanisms, allowing users with lower privilege roles to execute administrative actions that should be restricted. This weakness permits unauthorized operations on the affected product.
